ESET-008.note: Persisted Text/SpeechBalloon font family, fractional size (1..2000), bold, italic, Left/Center/Right alignment, Step font size (0..2000, 0 = automatic) and Step style use reference ImageEditorOptions field names, validate per field (invalid -> default + invalid-<field> diagnostic, whole multi-field change rejected), round-trip unknown fields, honour newer-version read-only and atomic failure. ESET-014.note: Four additive schema-v1 boolean preferences use the private atomic store, per-field repair and compatible unknown-field retention; guarded native Apply/Cancel and stale/failed write tests preserve the document. Auto-copy/auto-close run after task rendering and retain partial failures; ZoomToFitOnOpen changes viewport only; ShowExitConfirmation controls extra clean-close prompting and never dirty Save/Discard/Cancel. Deferred quick-crop: current pointer/numeric crop has required preview/Apply, no separate convenience behavior that can safely skip it. Deferred insert-dialog: current image picker/options are the sole validated insertion/consent path, no independently optional dialog behavior. Deferred notification: editor has status/completion/error reporting, no optional editor desktop-notification feature. Default rationale follows (not a parity claim): AutoCopyImageToClipboard=false: ShareX RegionCaptureOptions defaults EditorAutoCopyImage=false; Flameshot documents explicit Copy and save-after-copy=false; Greenshot documents explicit clipboard export; keep clipboard intent explicit. AutoCloseEditorOnTask=false: ShareX RegionCaptureOptions defaults AutoCloseEditorOnTask=false; Flameshot capture UI completes its chosen action (no equivalent standalone Continue); Greenshot retains editor/export workflow; keep review/recovery visible. ZoomToFitOnOpen=false: ShareX RegionCaptureOptions defaults ZoomToFitOnOpen=false; Flameshot works at captured screen scale (no standalone opening equivalent); Greenshot documents resizing the editor to the screenshot, rather than mandatory fit scaling; preserve 100% inspection and offer Fit. ShowExitConfirmation=false: none of the three cited user guides documents a mandatory extra clean-close confirmation; use quiet clean close while ES-008 dirty Save/Discard/Cancel remains mandatory. ShareX defaults for the first three fields were verified in primary source; Flameshot/Greenshot have different editor/task models, so remaining choices use documented behavior rather than a claim of equivalent toggles.
